A dynamic item in STATIC working-storage (a RECURSIVE program's or FUNCTION-ID's WS at 2023) is reset to its initial state by RunUnit.Terminate - the unit's __ResetStatics, adopted at its registration - so its resources are released at termination rather than held until the next run unit's registration. The same epilogue serves both run-unit boundaries (RunMain, RunUnit.Run).
